clues.text: The prophet Samuel poured a flask of oil on this young man's head, anointing him ruler over the LORD's inheritance.
When the people chose Israel's king by lot, the man they brought out stood a head taller than everyone.
After defeating the Amalekites, this king and his troops spared Agag along with the best sheep and cattle.
Israel's women danced and sang that this king had slain his thousands, but David his tens of thousands.
While David played the harp for him, this king tried to pin David to the wall with a spear.
Disguised in different clothes, this king of Israel went by night to a medium to call up a spirit.
Fighting the Philistines, this king asked his armor-bearer to kill him, then fell on his own sword.
